message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; git diff HEAD~1 HEAD -- error.c 2>/dev/null | head -100` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
Now I understand the vulnerability. The issue is that `xmlReportError` accesses `ctxt->input` (and `ctxt->inputTab[ctxt->inputNr - 2]`) which may point to freed memory. When an error occurs during parsing (e.g., while handling entities or external subsets), the parser input may have been freed, but `xmlReportError` still reads from it via `xmlParserPrintFileContextInternal`.

Let me look at the OSS-Fuzz testcase to understand what input triggers this. Let me first check the git history to understand the fix:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
